# Michael Crismali

Full stack software engineer based in Chicago, currently freelancing through [Semicolon Design Group](https://www.semicolon.group/the-group). Available for new projects.

## Contact

- GitHub: https://github.com/crismali
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/michael-crismali

## Professional

13+ years of experience (started 2013). Helps teams ship quality features for customers and internal users. Comfortable working across the full stack and with infrastructure when needed. Values maintainable, well-tested code.

### Skills

- JavaScript / TypeScript
- Ruby on Rails
- Elixir
- React / React Native
- HTML & CSS
- SQL (PostgreSQL)

### How I Work

- Test-driven development
- Conscientious use of AI — real leverage, reviewed like anything else I ship
- Comfortable working with anyone, from customers to executives
- Brings calm and steadiness to fast-moving teams

### Open Source & Community

- Volunteer developer for the [Chicago Tool Library](https://chicagotoollibrary.org)
- Speaker at RailsConf 2018
- Author of [MagicLamp](https://github.com/crismali/magic_lamp) and [FantaskSpec](https://github.com/crismali/fantaskspec)
- Contributor to [JsonbAccessor](https://github.com/madeintandem/jsonb_accessor)

## Projects

Things I've made on my own time.

- [Oh FEC](https://ohfec.org) — campaign finance explorer over the public OpenFEC record: candidates, committees, filings, donors, and outside-spending vendors, cached and cross-linked.
- [Nonprofiteer](https://nonprofiteer.us) — IRS Form 990 filings normalized and served as infrastructure (~2M organizations, ~10M officers/directors/key employees) over a JSON:API with keyset pagination.

Also a cowriter (one of eight) on *Are They Gonna Kiss?*, a sketch revue at The Second City, running at Donny's Skybox in Chicago, August–September 2026.

## Personal

Lives in Chicago with his wife and their 14-year-old dog, Luna. Interests include biking, movies, concerts, comic books, homemade ice cream, gardening, and slowly learning Italian.
